name: Button
description: Primary action control with an orthogonal variant (visual weight) and tone (semantic color) model, loading state, and polymorphic button/link rendering.

clickAction.description:
Async click handler. `onClick` still fires first if both are provided.
While the returned promise is pending, the button shows its `loading`
state, sets `aria-busy`, and disables itself (deduping repeat clicks).
Rejections are swallowed after clearing the pending state; callers own
error UX (e.g. surface a toast from within `clickAction` itself).

href.description: Destination URL. When provided, the button renders as an anchor.

surface.description: Surface the button renders on; prefer this over absolute colors on tinted bands.

disabled.description: Disables interaction and dims the control.

loading.description: Shows a loading state and blocks interaction; sets `aria-busy`.

icon.description: Leading icon: a React node, a component, or a Phosphor icon name (e.g. `"arrow-left"`).

endIcon.description: Trailing icon: a React node, a component, or a Phosphor icon name.

accessibleName.description: Accessible name; required for icon-only buttons. Maps to `aria-label`.

accessibleNameRef.description: id of an element that labels this button. Maps to `aria-labelledby`.

accessibleDescription.description: Extra context for assistive tech. Maps to `aria-describedby`.

tooltip.description: Native tooltip text; also used as an accessible-name fallback for icon-only buttons.

rules.reason: An icon-only button has no accessible name. Add accessibleName, accessibleNameRef, or tooltip, e.g. <Button icon="search" accessibleName="Search" />.
